summary: Four Leaf Acquisition Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of its Business Combination Agreement with Guangzhou Xiaoyu DiDa Technology Co., Ltd (XYDD), effective July 15, 2026. The termination was driven by a halt in the XYDD transaction due to PRC regulatory review and the SPAC's decision to pursue an alternative business combination with Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. No termination fee is payable by the SPAC. Instead, Data443 issued a $2M promissory note to XYDD as compensation, payable in two $1M installments after Data443's deal close. The filing signals a switch in SPAC targets and resolution of prior deal; watch for Data443 deal completion and remaining SPAC timeline.
